description: This file defines the Processor class in the Todaymade\Daux namespace. The class provides hook points for tree manipulation, extending Markdown environment, adding generators, and content types, primarily serving as an extension point or plugin component within a documentation generation system.

classes.name: Processor
classes.description: A class providing extension points for manipulating content trees, extending Markdown parsing environment, adding content generators, and content types within the documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Processor with dependencies including the main Daux object, console output interface, and width parameter.

methods.name: manipulateTree
methods.description: A hook to modify or transform the content tree before rendering.

methods.name: extendCommonMarkEnvironment
methods.description: A hook to extend or customize the Markdown parser and renderer environment.

methods.name: addGenerators
methods.description: Returns an array of additional content generators, with keys as format names and values as class names.

methods.name: addContentType
methods.description: Returns an array of additional content types to be used during generation.
